app_store.name: ResonaDSP Audio Equalizer
app_store.subtitle: System sound tuning for PC
app_store.promotional_text: System-wide parametric equalization, spline graphic curves, and channel matrix routing for Windows audio.
app_store.description:
ResonaDSP gives you studio-grade acoustic control over your Windows audio output and input streams.

Fine-tune headphones, calibrate desktop monitors, and enhance microphone clarity using an in-process digital signal processing engine.

Key features:
- Parametric biquad filtering with interactive logarithmic response canvas
- Arbitrary-band and ISO 31-band graphic equalizer with monotone cubic splines
- Arithmetic channel matrix routing and crossfeed processing
- Auto-healing registry guard for audio endpoints
- Direct Room EQ Wizard (REW) profile import

Runs locally with zero added buffering delay.
app_store.whats_new: Initial release with parametric filtering, 31-band spline equalizer, channel matrix routing, and automated endpoint registry protection.
